description:
Update workspace-wide channel defaults (rate limits, timeouts, tool mode).

These settings apply across all enabled channels:
- maxSessionsPerDay: Cap on inbound chat sessions per day (default 100)
- sessionTimeoutMinutes: Auto-close sessions after inactivity (default 60)
- toolMode: 'all' (all tools available) or 'mcp' (MCP-only tools)

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

max_sessions_per_day.description: Max inbound chat sessions per day (default 100)

session_timeout_minutes.description: Auto-close session after inactivity in minutes (default 60)

tool_mode.description: Default tool mode for channel chats: 'all' or 'mcp'

name: set_channel_defaults
